name: com.gameframex.unity.operationkeyboard.alipayminigame
displayName: Game Frame X Operation Keyboard (Alipay Mini Game)
description:
Alipay Mini Game keyboard adapter for GameFrameX OperationKeyboard. Implements IOperationKeyboardManager over AP.ShowKeyboard / AP.HideKeyboard with On/OffKeyboardInput / Confirm / Complete JSON callbacks, and self-registers into OperationKeyboardRegistry at BeforeSceneLoad via AliPayMiniGameOperationKeyboardBootstrap (code is stripped and registration does not happen when UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_ALIPAY_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_ALIPAY_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONKEYBOARD macros are not enabled — referencing means registering). Alipay expresses unlimited length as 0, so the core -1 is mapped internally; it has no UpdateKeyboard or height API and those members are empty by design. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX OperationKeyboard 的支付宝小游戏键盘适配渠道包。基于 AP.ShowKeyboard / AP.HideKeyboard 与 On/OffKeyboardInput / Confirm / Complete 的 JSON 回调实现 IOperationKeyboardManager，由 AliPayMiniGameOperationKeyboardBootstrap 在 BeforeSceneLoad 阶段自注册进 OperationKeyboardRegistry（宏 UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_ALIPAY_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_ALIPAY_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONKEYBOARD 未启用时代码被裁剪、注册不发生，引用即注册）。支付宝以 0 表示不限长，内部把核心的 -1 映射为 0；无 UpdateKeyboard 与键盘高度 API，对应成员为空实现。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
